title: Technical Software and IT Assistance
description: The prompts request technical explanations, comparisons, code, configuration guidance, and data extraction across AI models, programming, networking, and enterprise tools.

title: General Knowledge and Travel Questions
description: The prompts ask for brief factual information, recommendations, and practical advice across varied topics, with a notable emphasis on travel destinations and itineraries.

title: Requests for Explanations, Examples, and Summaries
description: These prompts ask for clear explanations of varied concepts and texts, often with examples, concise summaries, technical detail, or supporting references.

title: Business Writing and Content Assistance
description: These prompts request help drafting, rewriting, summarizing, and planning professional business content such as company descriptions, marketing materials, reports, strategies, and career documents.

title: Chatbot Roleplay and Persona Customization
description: These prompts ask the chatbot to adopt fictional characters, relationship roles, personalities, or communication styles, often with specific response formats and attempts to bypass its usual restrictions.

title: Classifying Behaviors as Acceptable or Wrong
description: Most prompts ask the assistant to judge everyday behaviors as okay, good, or wrong, alongside assorted text-rewriting, summarization, and classification tasks.

title: Creative Writing and Storytelling Requests
description: These prompts ask for original stories, poems, scripts, and other creative narrative content, as well as help continuing, revising, summarizing, or evaluating writing.

title: Python Programming Help and Code Generation
description: These prompts request Python code, examples, explanations, debugging, testing, and guidance for building programs ranging from basic exercises to games, scripts, and applications.

title: Requests for Explicit Erotic Fiction and Roleplay
description: These prompts ask for sexually explicit stories, dialogue, rewrites, or roleplay involving a wide range of fetishes, relationship scenarios, and taboo themes.

title: Elementary Math and Logic Word Problems
description: The prompts ask for answers and often step-by-step explanations to basic arithmetic, counting, sequencing, and logic puzzles, including trick questions and ambiguous scenarios.

title: Questions and Creative Requests About Named Entities
description: These prompts ask for information, comparisons, relationships, or creative writing and roleplay involving named people, characters, concepts, and other entities.

title: Structured Information Extraction from Text
description: These prompts ask AI systems to identify, classify, or transform information from varied text into structured outputs, most often JSON or another specified format.

title: Chatbot Instructions and Jailbreak Prompts
description: These prompts primarily define chatbot roles, response formats, and task behaviors, often attempting to bypass safety restrictions or elicit harmful or unrestricted content.

title: Requests for Toxic Responses in Everyday Situations
description: These prompts ask chatbots to produce brief toxic, harmful, or insulting remarks for a wide range of interpersonal situations, often framed around a demographic identity.

title: Assistant Identity and Python Help
description: The prompts mostly ask who the assistant is, alongside requests for beginner-friendly Python explanations and code examples on common programming tasks.

title: General Multilingual AI Assistance Requests
description: These prompts ask an AI assistant for varied help, including translation, summaries, writing and content creation, coding, technical questions, and conversational role-play.

title: Chemical Industry Articles on Organic Compounds
description: The prompts request long-form articles about the production, synthesis, applications, safety, and supply-chain products of diverse organic chemicals, especially nitrogen-containing heterocycles and pharmaceutical intermediates.

title: Long-Form Introductions for Chemical Companies
description: The prompts ask for lengthy company introductions for chemical, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and related businesses, often providing a company name and location.

title: Fact-Checking Summaries Against Source Documents
description: These prompts ask whether summaries are factually consistent with supplied documents or articles, often requiring a yes-or-no judgment and brief explanation of mismatches.

title: Plant Seed Growing Requirements and Botanical Information
description: These prompts primarily request cultivation conditions for various plant seeds—such as temperature, sunlight, rainfall, humidity, and soil—alongside related botanical and plant-species information.
